description: Embark on a thrilling 7-day adventure in Bali, Denpasar, for two. This itinerary focuses on exciting outdoor activities, from ziplining and biking to snorkeling and mountain hikes, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

accommodation.amenities: wifi, beach access, pool, airport shuttle, rooftop terrace

days.title: Arrival and Relaxation
days.description: Arrive in Denpasar, check into your hotel, and enjoy some leisure time by the pool or beach to unwind after your journey.

days.title: Zipline and Ropes Adventure
days.description: Kick off your adventure with an exhilarating zipline and ropes course experience.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll experience thrilling ziplines and challenging rope courses amidst natural surroundings.What to bring: Wear comfortable athletic clothing, closed-toe shoes, and bring water.What to eat: Grab a light snack before your adventure, as food options might be limited on site.Good to know: This activity is suitable for adventure seekers and offers a high-rated experience.

days.title: Snorkelling Day Trip
days.description: Explore the vibrant underwater world of Bali with a snorkelling day trip.

activities.activity_name: Snorkelling Day Trip from Denpasar — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Discover colorful coral reefs and diverse marine life in the clear waters.What to bring: Bring your swimwear, towel, sunscreen, and a waterproof camera.What to eat: A light meal or snacks are often provided on snorkelling trips, but confirm with the tour operator.Good to know: This afternoon edition is perfect for those who prefer a later start and is suitable for families and adventure seekers.

days.title: Mountain Hike and Scenic Views
days.description: Embark on a refreshing mountain hike to enjoy panoramic views of Denpasar's landscapes.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Enjoy breathtaking vistas from various viewpoints during your mountain trek.What to bring: Wear sturdy hiking shoes, comfortable clothing, a hat, sunscreen, and plenty of water.What to eat: Pack some energy-boosting snacks and consider a packed lunch for the hike.Good to know: This activity is ideal for active travellers looking for a challenging and rewarding experience.

days.title: Bike Tour and Cultural Immersion
days.description: Experience Denpasar's local life and scenic routes on a guided bike tour.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Cycle through local villages, rice paddies, and experience the daily life of Denpasar.What to bring: Wear comfortable clothing, closed-toe shoes, sunscreen, and bring a water bottle.What to eat: You might stop for local snacks or refreshments during the tour, so bring some cash.Good to know: This tour is suitable for active travellers and families, offering a unique perspective of the city.

days.title: Sunset Cruise and Local Flavors
days.description: Enjoy a relaxing sunset cruise followed by a delightful local dinner experience.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Witness a beautiful sunset over the ocean with stunning coastal views.What to bring: A light jacket, camera, and perhaps some cash for drinks on board.What to eat: Enjoy light refreshments on the cruise, and plan for dinner at a local restaurant afterwards.Good to know: This cruise is a perfect romantic or family-friendly activity to end your day.

activities.activity_name: Denpasar Cooking Class with Local Chef — Private Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn to prepare traditional Balinese dishes from a local chef in a private setting.What to bring: An appetite and a willingness to learn new culinary skills.What to eat: You will enjoy the delicious meal you prepare during the class.Good to know: This private cooking class is perfect for couples or families looking for an immersive cultural and culinary experience.

days.title: Departure Preparation
days.description: Enjoy a final Balinese breakfast and prepare for your departure from Denpasar.

warnings: Budget total corrected from 0.00 AUD to 6290.00 AUD.
